'restaurant-only' is NOT a valid identity.type (Zod enum backend/src/api/tenant-import.js:15 + D1 CHECK backend/migrations/0001_core.sql:19) so identity uses type 'other' + businessType 'restaurant-only'; the restaurant core is menu+posUsers while rooms (dining cabins) + ratePlans (weekend/friday pricing) keep the file schema-complete. meal_grill shows the direct mealCategoryId path (the placeholder id must already exist in the target tenant — a missing id violates meals.meal_category_id (NOT NULL + FK) and fails the import as a raw 500, not a silent null). campId/categoryId/storeId placeholders must match the target tenant or be omitted for handler fallbacks. Passwords are example-only.
